description: Qwen3-4B artifacts for the RK1828 PCIe NPU (RKNN3/RKLLM3 V1.0.4 toolchain). The four files are a MATCHED SET from one export — a mismatched .rknn/.weight pair will not load, so never mix versions or sources.

verified_runtime.note: 8192 loaded first try with no MODEL_SETUP failure and is the recommended default. max_context is a RUNTIME parameter, not compiled into the .rknn — 2048 -> 8192 -> 16384 all needed no re-export. 16384 is ALSO VERIFIED to load (first attempt, READY, TTFT 132 ms / 81.3 tok/s, v2v p50 839 ms — identical to 8192), but it puts EP usage at an estimated ~92% of 5120 MB versus ~71% at 8192. Since this platform gives NO way to measure EP memory and a FAILED load degrades the card from 8 cores to 4, production stays at 8192 for headroom; raise it deliberately if a workload needs the context.

files.name: Qwen3-4B.embed.bin
files.role: embedding table (mmapped on the HOST, does not consume EP memory)

published_at.note: sha256 values below were verified end to end: computed on the upload host and confirmed equal to the LFS oid Hugging Face reports. NOTE the origin (huggingface.co) is NOT reachable from every device — on a CN device set HF_ENDPOINT to a mirror (hf-mirror.com has these synced).
